title: Leafy greens in beds and containers
subcategory: Leafy greens in beds and containers
summary: Grow quick leaves with cool-season timing, steady moisture and repeated harvest.
steps: Choose lettuce, chard, spinach-like greens or local varieties suited to the current temperature.
Sow shallowly in clean fine soil and thin early so leaves receive airflow.
Keep moisture even without permanent saturation; shade may extend harvest during warming weather.
Harvest outer clean leaves or cut at the recommended stage while the plant is crisp.
Remove bolting, bitter or diseased plants and start a new small sowing in a better window.
